title: Step 3 - NLP in R: Initialising a Corpus for Sentiment Analysis

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So, in the previous tutorials we imported the data set and we started with the big first step of natural language processing, which is about cleaning the text we are working with.
cues.zh: 前幾堂匯入資料集，開始 NLP 第一個大步驟，清理文字。

cues.en: So, this first step consisted of creating a corpus that basically is a new data set but this time only containing the reviews, the text of the reviews,
cues.zh: 先建立 corpus，基本上是新資料集，但只含評論文字，

cues.en: and basically this is in this corpus that we're gonna clean all the 1000 reviews.
cues.zh: 會在裡面清理全部一千則。

cues.en: And we are gonna clean them step by step, and in this tutorial we're gonna do the first cleaning step.
cues.zh: 逐步清理，這堂做第一種。

cues.en: All right, So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: This first cleaning step will consist of putting all the reviews in lower cases.
cues.zh: 全部轉小寫。

cues.en: And what is the purpose of doing that?
cues.zh: 目的何在？

cues.en: Well, we are doing this so that in the final sparse matrix containing all the words of our 1000 reviews, we don't get twice the same word with one word starting with the capital letter
cues.zh: 讓包含一千則評論所有詞的最終稀疏矩陣，不會重複同個詞，一個以大寫

cues.en: and the same word but not starting with the capital letter.
cues.zh: 開頭，另一個沒有。

cues.en: And, of course, we only want to have one version of the same word and therefore we'll keep the one with lowercase.
cues.zh: 只要同詞一個版本，所以留小寫。

cues.en: So, that's why right now in this first step of the cleaning process, we will put all the words of our 1000 reviews in lower cases.
cues.zh: 因此第一步，把一千則評論全部詞轉小寫。

cues.en: So, let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: To do this we are going to update the corpus this way, then equals because we are updating it.
cues.zh: 更新 corpus，這樣，等於，因為要更新。

cues.en: That is it will contain new reviews which are gonna be the same reviews but with lower cases, and to put all the words of the reviews in this corpus
cues.zh: 會含新評論，原本評論但全小寫；要把語料庫所有評論的詞

cues.en: we will use the TM underscore map function, that will do the job for us.
cues.zh: 轉小寫，用 tm_map。

cues.en: So, function so we need to add some parenthesis and now we need to add two parameters, the first parameter is actually the corpus itself but you know the old version of the corpus,
cues.zh: 函式加括號，兩參數。第一是 corpus 本身，但舊版，

cues.en: that is the corpus that we have here, which contains the original versions of the reviews, that is the 1000 reviews we have in our data set, and this corpus here
cues.zh: 也就是這裡包含原始一千則評論的語料庫；這裡的 corpus，

cues.en: will be the new updated version of the corpus, that is the corpus containing all the reviews in lower cases.
cues.zh: 會是新版，所有評論全小寫。

cues.en: So, that's the first parameter the old version of the corpus, and the second parameter is a function that is some kind of a transform function,
cues.zh: 第一參數舊 corpus，第二是某種轉換函式，

cues.en: and that will simply transform each word of the corpus by replacing the capital letters in lower case.
cues.zh: 逐詞把大寫換小寫。

cues.en: So, this function is content underscore transformer.
cues.zh: 叫 content_transformer。

cues.en: Here it is, let's press enter here.
cues.zh: 來了，Enter。

cues.en: And actually this content transformer function can perform several transformations, as we can see in the yellow rectangle here.
cues.zh: 它能做多種轉換，黃色框有說明。

cues.en: The parameter of this function is fun, and so we need to add the function that we want to put all the words of the reviews in lower cases,
cues.zh: 參數 fun，填把評論所有詞轉小寫的函式，

cues.en: and this function is called to lower.
cues.zh: 叫 tolower。

cues.en: All right, so that's the function parameter that we need to input in this content transformer which is like a transformed function having several transformation possibilities as input here,
cues.zh: 這就是 content_transformer 要輸入的函式；它能接受多種轉換，

cues.en: and the possibility that we choose is this two lower function which will put all the words in lower cases.
cues.zh: 我們選 tolower。

cues.en: And basically this TM map function is used so that we can apply this content transformer to lower function for all the words of the 1000 reviews of the corpus.
cues.zh: tm_map 讓 content_transformer(tolower) 套用到 corpus 一千則評論所有詞。

cues.en: Great, so that's actually done, that's actually all we need to put all the words of the 1000 reviews in lower cases so I'm gonna show you now what it does.
cues.zh: 很好，這樣就能全部轉小寫，現在示範效果。

cues.en: So, what we'll do before selecting this and executing this, what we'll do is have a look at one review of the corpus, let's take the first review,
cues.zh: 選取執行前，先看 corpus 一則，第一則，

cues.en: and then we'll run this line of code and you'll see what it does to this first review.
cues.zh: 執行後看它如何變。

cues.en: Okay, so let's access to the first review, and to do this we need to use the as.character and then in parenthesis, we input the corpus.
cues.zh: 存取第一則，用 as.character，括號 corpus。

cues.en: But then since we wanna look at the first review of this corpus, well, we need to add some double brackets, actually, and one, because this is the index of the first review
cues.zh: 因為要第一則，加雙層方括號和 1，第一則索引，

cues.en: because index is in R start at one.
cues.zh: 因為 R 索引從 1 開始。

cues.en: So, this way we'll have a look at the first review and since the corpus is kind of a complicated object we need to use this double brackets here to access to the written review
cues.zh: 這樣查看；corpus 物件較複雜，要用雙方括號存取文字，

cues.en: and, besides, we need to use this as.character function to have this written review displayed.
cues.zh: 再用 as.character 顯示。

cues.en: All right, so I'm going to press enter here and, as I just told you, we get the written review, "Wow, love this place," which is of course the first review
cues.zh: 按 Enter，取得 Wow, love this place，第一則，

cues.en: as we can see in our dataset, "Wow, love this place."
cues.zh: 資料集也能看到。

cues.en: All right, so that's the first review, that's the original version of the first review.
cues.zh: 這是第一則原始版。

cues.en: And now we are going to apply the first step of the cleaning process, which is to put all the reviews and lower cases.
cues.zh: 現在套清理第一步，評論全小寫。

cues.en: So, let's do it, let's select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選這行執行。

cues.en: All right, so as you can see it was very fast.
cues.zh: 很快。

cues.en: All the 1000 reviews were just transformed in lower cases, so let's check it out, let's check it out for the first review.
cues.zh: 一千則剛都轉好了，檢查第一則。

cues.en: So, we just need to press the up arrow to get the previous command, which is this one.
cues.zh: 按向上箭頭取得上一命令，就是這個。

cues.en: And since our new corpus is also called corpus we just updated the corpus, well, we can run this and hopefully we'll get the same review written in lower cases.
cues.zh: 新版也叫 corpus，只是更新過，執行應得到小寫評論。

cues.en: So, let's check it out, let's press enter here.
cues.zh: 按 Enter。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 來了。

cues.en: As you can see, the capital W became this little W and this capital L became this lower L.
cues.zh: 大寫 W 變小寫，大寫 L 也變小寫。

cues.en: Perfect, so first simplification now in the final big table, the final sparse matrix, we won't get two versions of the same word, one in capital letter and one in lowercase,
cues.zh: 很好，第一個簡化，未來大表格、稀疏矩陣，不會同詞大寫、小寫兩版本，

cues.en: we'll get one unique version of the word and therefore we did the first simplification of our future sparse matrix.
cues.zh: 只有唯一版本，首次簡化未來矩陣。

cues.en: So, that's the first good thing done and now we will proceed to the next step of the cleaning process, which will be to remove all the numbers of the reviews, because indeed the numbers are not very relevant
cues.zh: 第一件好事完成，下一步清理是移除評論所有數字，因為通常對判斷

cues.en: in telling if a review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 正面或負面無關。

cues.en: Well, we need to be cautious actually because maybe some reviews are on a scale of one to 10 I give a 10, well, that's definitely a number that is fully correlated
cues.zh: 但其實要小心，可能有評論說「一到十我給十分」，這數字顯然與

cues.en: to the outcome, whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 正負結果完全相關。

cues.en: So, we should pay attention to that but we could have other numbers that are totally irrelevant, like some addresses that contain numbers or phone numbers, well, that would be a little weird in the review
cues.zh: 必須注意，但其他數字可能完全無關，例如地址、電話；出現在評論有點奇怪，

cues.en: but we never know.
cues.zh: 但難說。

cues.en: Well, in general, when we are dealing with text, when we're working with text, we want to get rid of the numbers because these are most of the time not very relevant and this could add a lot more columns,
cues.zh: 一般處理文字想去數字，因為多半無關，也可能多出很多欄，

cues.en: so in general it's better to remove the numbers.
cues.zh: 所以通常移除較好。

cues.en: So, that's what we'll do in the next tutorial and until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 下一堂來做，在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
